name: Alpaca Agent
description: Operates this repository's supported Alpaca asset, account, holdings, market-data, rebalance, and analytical portfolio workflows through verified project tools.

extensions.description: Select whether message:send returns a completed message or an asynchronous task.

skills.name: Alpaca Asset Registration
skills.description: Inspect canonical Alpaca-backed Assets and plan or execute exact-symbol registration using a registered Account's Secret references.
examples: Plan registration for AAPL and NVDA through my registered Alpaca account.

skills.name: Alpaca Accounts And Holdings
skills.description: Register Alpaca Accounts from keys the person enters on the Alpaca site or from existing Main Sequence Secret names, replace their keys, and inspect or capture their ms-markets holdings snapshots.
examples: Register my live Alpaca account; I have the API key and secret key.
Register a paper account from these two Main Sequence Secret names and show its initial holdings.

skills.name: Alpaca Stock Bars
skills.description: Manage stored Alpaca bar configurations, resolve their configured Asset scope and migrated dataset, run updates, and query observations.
examples: Resolve this daily bars configuration that follows my portfolios and run its update Job.

skills.name: Analytical Portfolios
skills.description: Read, run, pause, resume, and delete analytical portfolios built from the weights an application provides, manage calendar-event rebalance rules, and read their history and statistics.
examples: Run this analytical portfolio and show its performance and statistics.
